title: phalaris decumbens
intro: Phalaris decumbens, commonly known as tick grass or tufted phalaris, is a perennial grass native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phalaris decumbens include soothing and calming effects, which have been traditionally used to treat anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Phalaris decumbens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
